spec.situation_desc: had a loan application declined with no explanation

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good morning, you’re speaking to Sam at Thistle Bank. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi, I’m Aoife Okonkwo. My loan application was declined and nobody’s explained why. I’m really unhappy about it.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry this has been frustrating, Aoife. Before I look at anything about your application, could you confirm your full name and date of birth, please?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you. And the first line of your address?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thanks, that’s verified. I understand you’re unhappy that your loan application was declined without an explanation.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: That’s right. I want to know why it happened.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I can’t give you a reason for the decision on this call. I am logging this as a complaint about the decline and the lack of an explanation.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: You’ll hear back within five working days. I can’t promise what the outcome will be.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Just to summarise, I’ve logged your complaint about the loan decision and not being given an explanation. You’ll hear back within five working days, though I can’t say what the outcome will be. Does that make sense?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you for confirming, Aoife. Is there anything else you’d like to raise today?
